description: This Java source file defines the EntityUtilProperties class, which provides utility methods for accessing, modifying, and managing property values related to system and entity configurations in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles retrieval of properties from various sources such as property files, database, URLs, and supports locale-aware message and resource bundle handling.

classes.name: EntityUtilProperties
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to access and manipulate system and entity properties, supporting multiple sources including files, database, URLs, and locale-specific resources.

methods.name: getSystemPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the property value from the database if exists, otherwise returns default from properties files.

methods.name: propertyValueEquals
methods.description: Checks if a property value equals a given string.

methods.name: propertyValueEqualsIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if a property value equals a given string, ignoring case.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Fetches the property value as string, considering database overrides.

methods.name: getPropertyValueFromDelegatorName
methods.description: Retrieves property value using a specified delegator name.

methods.name: getPropertyNumber
methods.description: Returns the property value as a number.

methods.name: getPropertyAsBoolean
methods.description: Returns the property as a Boolean.

methods.name: getPropertyAsInteger
methods.description: Returns the property as an Integer.

methods.name: getPropertyAsLong
methods.description: Returns the property as a Long.

methods.name: getPropertyAsFloat
methods.description: Returns the property as a Float.

methods.name: getPropertyAsDouble
methods.description: Returns the property as a Double.

methods.name: getPropertyAsBigInteger
methods.description: Returns the property as a BigInteger.

methods.name: getPropertyAsBigDecimal
methods.description: Returns the property as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Loads properties from resource, URL, or with a delegator context.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Fetches localized message strings from resource bundles.

methods.name: getResourceBundle
methods.description: Gets a ResourceBundle for a given resource and locale.

methods.name: createResourceName
methods.description: Creates a locale-aware resource file name.

methods.name: isPropertiesResourceNotFound
methods.description: Checks if a resource file is missing for a given locale.

methods.name: resolvePropertiesUrl
methods.description: Resolves a resource URL for a resource and locale.

methods.name: xmlToProperties
methods.description: Converts XML input stream to Properties object considering locale.
